_note: Data for the programs J2 builds and runs (read by j2.py, beside it). requester_only: what Decide for me never answers, whatever the kind of the question: each row is a pattern (whole words, any case) looked for in the open question, its options and Identity's message, and `about`, the plain words the chat line gives as the reason. Code adds two checks that read no words: a question tagged with a done-when item a planned real run decides, and a decision whose leave-out option names such an item. run_output: the record code writes after an approved real run (schema run-output/1). folder: where, in the run folder; name, kind, label, tag and color: its row in artifacts.json; limits: stdout_lines and stderr_lines (the last lines kept of each), tail_bytes (the most bytes of either tail), max_files (the most files listed, over created, changed and deleted), text_cap_bytes (the largest main result whose text is copied).
